items.title_cn: 即刻与按需内镜下坏死组织清除术治疗感染性坏死性胰腺炎的有效性、安全性和成本：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: Efficacy, safety, and cost of immediate versus on-demand endoscopic necrosectomy in infected necrotizing pancreatitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其通过系统综述与meta分析比较了感染性坏死性胰腺炎中即刻与按需内镜下坏死清除术的疗效、安全性和成本，属于重症胰腺炎阶梯治疗及内镜下坏死清除术的核心研究方向；但摘要内容缺失，无法提取具体发现。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎出院并非终点：被忽视的胰腺炎后糖尿病风险
items.title_en: Acute pancreatitis does not end at discharge: the forgotten risk of post-pancreatitis diabetes
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 急性胰腺炎（AP）传统上被认为是一种急性炎症性疾病，患者在疼痛缓解、器官功能障碍改善并处理病因后即可康复。然而，出院时胰腺功能可能并未完全恢复。越来越多的证据表明，AP与显著的长期糖代谢异常风险及胰腺炎后糖尿病（PPDM）相关，包括在轻症、非坏死性疾病之后。PPDM的机制具有异质性，可能包括胰腺组织丢失、炎症相关β细胞功能障碍、胰岛素抵抗、肠促胰岛素信号改变以及胰岛素分泌受损。因此，出院时血糖浓度正常不应被视为长期内分泌功能恢复的证据。AP的严重程度和胰腺坏死的存在会增加风险，但将监测仅限于重症患者可能会遗漏相当比例随后发生糖代谢异常的临床相关患者。当前国际建议提供了实用的随访框架，即在康复后约3–6个月评估糖代谢，此后继续每年评估。重症或坏死性疾病、复发性AP、代谢危险因素或糖代谢异常持续进展的患者可能需要更密切的监测。下一个挑战是从仅仅在AP后诊断糖尿病，转向在糖尿病发生之前识别高危患者。急性期血糖模式可能提供预后信息，尽管当前证据尚不足以支持常规预测评分或连续血糖监测用于PPDM筛查。需要进一步研究以确定早期识别和靶向干预能否改变AP后的代谢轨迹。将内分泌功能恢复视为AP康复的附加组成部分，可能为改善患者长期照护提供重要机会。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Acute pancreatitis (AP) is traditionally considered an acute inflammatory illness from which patients recover once pain resolves, organ dysfunction improves, and the underlying cause is addressed. However, pancreatic recovery may not be complete at discharge. Increasing evidence indicates that AP is associated with a substantial long-term risk of dysglycemia and post-pancreatitis diabetes mellitus (PPDM), including after mild, non-necrotizing disease. The mechanisms underlying PPDM are heterogeneous and may include loss of pancreatic tissue, inflammation-related β-cell dysfunction, insulin resistance, altered incretin signaling, and impaired insulin secretion. Consequently, a normal glucose concentration at discharge should not be considered evidence of long-term endocrine recovery. The severity of AP and the presence of pancreatic necrosis increase the risk, but restricting surveillance to patients with severe disease may overlook a clinically relevant proportion of patients who subsequently develop dysglycemia. Current international recommendations provide a practical framework for follow-up, with assessment of glucose metabolism approximately 3–6 months after recovery and continued annual assessment thereafter. Patients with severe or necrotizing disease, recurrent AP, metabolic risk factors, or evolving dysglycemia may require closer surveillance. The next challenge is to move beyond simply diagnosing diabetes after AP toward identifying patients at risk before diabetes develops. Acute-phase glycemic patterns may provide prognostic information, although current evidence is insufficient to support routine prediction scores or continuous glucose monitoring for PPDM screening. Further research is needed to determine whether early identification and targeted intervention can alter the metabolic trajectory following AP. Recognition of endocrine recovery as an additional component of recovery from AP may provide an important opportunity to improve long-term patient care.
items.journal: The Egyptian Journal of Internal Medicine
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题提示急性胰腺炎出院后仍存在被忽视的血胰源性糖尿病（post-pancreatitis diabetes）风险，强调急性胰腺炎的疾病管理不应止于出院。由于未提供摘要，无法进一步总结具体研究发现。

items.title_cn: 内镜超声在自身免疫性胰腺炎中的进展：组织获取、影像创新、人工智能及多学科整合
items.title_en: Advances in endoscopic ultrasound for autoimmune pancreatitis: Tissue acquisition, imaging innovations, artificial intelligence, and multidisciplinary integrations
items.abstract_cn: 自身免疫性胰腺炎（AIP）是一种免疫介导的胰腺炎症性疾病，难以与胰腺恶性肿瘤相鉴别，因此诊断仍然具有挑战性。1型AIP是免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病的胰腺表现，可与其他系统性纤维炎症性疾病相关。2型AIP的组织学特征为粒细胞上皮病变，常与炎症性肠病相关。近年来，超声内镜（EUS）已成为疑似AIP患者诊断评估的重要组成部分，尤其是当影像学检查显示局灶性胰腺增大或肿块样病变时。EUS成像的最新进展，包括超声内镜造影谐波成像和EUS弹性成像，可能改善胰腺病变的特征描述，并有助于区分炎症性胰腺过程与胰腺恶性肿瘤。此外，EUS引导下的组织获取在此背景下发挥着重要作用，可对病变进行组织学评估，从而帮助排除恶性肿瘤。EUS引导下的细针穿刺活检目前是首选的组织获取技术，因为它能够保留组织结构，有助于促进AIP的诊断。由肝胆胰内镜、肝病学、风湿病学、放射学、心脏病学、肾脏病学和组织病理学专家组成的多学科团队协作方式，对于整合诊断评估的不同组成部分并指导后续管理具有重要价值。最后，新兴的EUS人工智能算法可能支持诊断过程并促进AIP的识别。本综述讨论了当前和新兴的EUS技术、组织获取选择、安全性考量、多学科整合以及人工智能在AIP诊断和管理中的潜在作用。
items.abstract_en: Autoimmune pancreatitis (AIP) is an immune-mediated inflammatory condition of the pancreas that can be difficult to differentiate from pancreatic malignancy and therefore remains challenging to diagnose. Type 1 AIP is the pancreatic manifestation of immunoglobulin G subclass 4-related disease and can be associated with other systemic fibro-inflammatory conditions. Type 2 AIP is characterised histologically by granulocytic epithelial lesions and is frequently associated with inflammatory bowel disease. Over the previous years, endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) has become an important part of the diagnostic work-up of patients presenting with suspected AIP, particularly when imaging studies demonstrate focal pancreatic enlargement, or a mass-like lesion. Recent advances in EUS imaging, including contrast-enhanced harmonic EUS and EUS elastography, may improve characterisation of the pancreatic lesion and help distinguish an inflammatory pancreatic process from a pancreatic malignancy. Moreover, EUS-guided tissue acquisition plays an important role in this context by allowing histological assessment of the lesion and hence helping exclude a malignancy. EUS-guided fine-needle biopsy is currently the preferred tissue acquisition technique, as it allows the preservation of tissue architecture, which helps facilitate the diagnosis of AIP. A multidisciplinary approach involving a panel of specialists in hepatopancreatobiliary endoscopy, hepatology, rheumatology, radiology, cardiology, nephrology, and histopathology is valuable for integrating the different components of the diagnostic work-up and guiding subsequent management. Finally, emerging artificial intelligence algorithms for EUS may support the diagnostic process and facilitate recognition of AIP. This review discusses current and emerging EUS techniques, tissue acquisition options, safety considerations, multidisciplinary integration and the potential role of artificial intelligence in the diagnosis and management of AIP.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出EUS在疑似AIP的诊断评估中日益重要，尤其是局灶性胰腺增大或肿块样病变时；超声内镜成像新技术（对比增强谐波EUS、EUS弹性成像）可改善病变表征并帮助区分炎症与恶性肿瘤，EUS引导的细针活检因保留组织结构而成为首选取材技术。多学科整合及新兴人工智能算法有望进一步支持AIP的诊断与管理。

items.title_cn: 24小时平均血糖水平与急性胰腺炎患者死亡率的关联
items.title_en: Association of 24 hour mean blood glucose levels with mortality in patients with acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在探讨24小时平均血糖（24h MBG）水平对急性胰腺炎（AP）住院患者死亡率的影响，并探索该关联的临床意义。采用医学信息市场重症监护-IV数据库对AP患者的临床数据集进行回顾性分析。通过X-tile工具确定24h MBG水平的最佳阈值。采用单因素和多因素logistic回归分析评估24h MBG水平的预后意义。进行生存分析，并构建Kaplan-Meier生存曲线以展示随时间变化的生存概率。为增强结果有效性并减少协变量混杂，采用1：1倾向性评分匹配（PSM）技术。同时使用eICU数据库中766例AP患者队列进行外部验证。本研究共纳入977名受试者。24h MBG水平预测院内死亡率的最佳截断值确定为146 mg/dL。经PSM分析后，识别出336对受试者，大多数基线特征达到均衡。Kaplan-Meier生存分析表明，24h MBG≥146 mg/dL的患者与24h MBG<146 mg/dL的患者相比，院内、30天和90天死亡率显著升高（P<.05）。多因素logistic回归分析在调整潜在混杂因素后表明，24h MBG≥146 mg/dL的患者相对于平均血糖<146 mg/dL的患者，院内死亡率的比值比显著增加（比值比=3.9，95%置信区间：1.86~8.21，P<.001）。在PSM调整队列中观察到一致的结果。我们的研究结果表明，24h MBG水平与AP患者死亡率之间存在显著相关性。本研究呈现的结果具有显著性，并强调医疗保健提供者在有效管理死亡率时有必要考虑24h MBG水平的影响。
items.abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the impact of 24 hour mean blood glucose (24h MBG) levels on the mortality of patients hospitalized with acute pancreatitis (AP) and to explore the clinical implications of this association. A retrospective examination of clinical datasets of AP patients was performed using the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care-IV database. The optimal 24h MBG levels threshold was determined by the X-tile tool. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were used to assess the prognostic significance of 24h MBG levels. A survival analysis was carried out, and Kaplan–Meier survival curves were constructed to show survival probabilities over time. To strengthen result validity and reduce covariate confounding, a 1:1 propensity score matching (PSM) technique was implemented. An external validation was also performed with a cohort of 766 AP patients from the eICU database. A total of 977 subjects were enrolled in this study. The 24h MBG level’s optimal cutoff for predicting in-hospital mortality was determined to be 146 mg/dL. Following PSM analysis, 336 pairs of subjects were identified, achieving equilibrium in most baseline characteristics. Kaplan–Meier survival analysis demonstrated that patients with 24h MBG of 146 mg/dL or higher exhibited significantly elevated rates of in-hospital, 30-day, and 90-day mortality compared to those with 24h MBG below 146 mg/dL ( P < .05 ). Multivariate logistic regression analysis, after adjusting for potential confounding factors, indicated that patients with 24h MBG of 146 mg/dL or higher had a markedly increased odds of in-hospital mortality relative to those with a mean BG below 146 mg/dL (odds ratio = 3.9, 95% confidence interval: 1.86~8.21, P < .001 ). Consistent results were observed in the PSM-adjusted cohort. Our findings indicate a significant correlation between 24h MBG levels and mortality in patients who have suffered from AP. The results presented in this study are significant and emphasize the necessity for healthcare providers to take into account the impact of 24h MBG levels in effectively managing mortality.
items.summary_cn: 在急性胰腺炎患者中，24小时平均血糖（24h MBG）≥146 mg/dL与院内、30天及90天死亡率显著升高相关；经倾向性评分匹配和多因素校正后，该阈值仍与院内死亡风险增加独立相关（OR=3.9）。

items.title_cn: 入院时胸腔积液、首日液体管理及高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎的疾病严重程度：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Admission pleural effusion, first-day fluid administration, and disease severity in hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis: A retrospective cohort study

items.title_cn: 奥曲肽通过调控HMGB1-Wnt/β-catenin轴减轻实验性慢性胰腺炎中的胰腺纤维化
items.title_en: Octreotide attenuates pancreatic fibrosis through modulation of the HMGB1-Wnt/β-catenin axis in experimental chronic pancreatitis.

items.title_cn: 重新审视慢性胰腺炎作为胰腺导管腺癌危险因素：迈向精准风险分层
items.title_en: Revisiting chronic pancreatitis as a risk factor for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: toward precision risk stratification.
items.abstract_cn: 引言：慢性胰腺炎（CP）是胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的公认危险因素。然而，个体风险差异显著，CP与PDAC之间的关联比单一的炎症驱动通路更为复杂。反向因果关系、共享病因学因素以及生物学异质性可能共同导致了所观察到的关联。涵盖领域：我们批判性地审视了将CP与PDAC相关联的流行病学、机制性和因果性证据，重点关注CP不同亚型及疾病轨迹之间的异质性。我们考察了五个可能与个体PDAC风险相关的领域：遗传易感性、累积性胰腺损伤、包括新发糖尿病在内的代谢轨迹、纵向影像学表型以及新兴的分子改变。我们提出了一个多领域框架，用于个体化和动态风险分层及风险适应性监测。专家意见：CP不应被视为PDAC的均一高危状态。个体风险由遗传、炎症、代谢、结构和分子因素的相互作用所塑造。因此，关键问题应从CP是否增加PDAC风险转变为哪些患者最可能发展为具有临床意义的PDAC。尽管多领域和纵向评估可能有助于实现靶向监测，但大多数生物标志物和预测策略仍缺乏充分验证。需要开展前瞻性研究以确定该方法是否能改善早期检测和患者预后。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Chronic pancreatitis (CP) is an established risk factor for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). However, individual risk varies substantially, and the association between CP and PDAC is more complex than a uniform inflammation-driven pathway. Reverse causation, shared etiological factors, and biological heterogeneity may contribute to the observed association. AREAS COVERED: We critically review epidemiological, mechanistic, and causal evidence linking CP with PDAC, focusing on heterogeneity across CP subtypes and disease trajectories. We examine five domains potentially relevant to individual PDAC risk: genetic susceptibility, cumulative pancreatic injury, metabolic trajectories including new-onset diabetes, longitudinal imaging phenotypes, and emerging molecular alterations. We propose a multidomain framework for individualized and dynamic risk stratification and risk-adapted surveillance. EXPERT OPINION: CP should not be regarded as a uniformly high-risk condition for PDAC. Individual risk is shaped by the interaction of genetic, inflammatory, metabolic, structural, and molecular factors. The key question should therefore shift from whether CP increases PDAC risk to which patients are most likely to develop clinically consequential PDAC. Although multidomain and longitudinal assessment may enable targeted surveillance, most biomarkers and prediction strategies remain insufficiently validated. Prospective studies are required to determine whether this approach improves early detection and patient outcomes.
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其聚焦于慢性胰腺炎作为胰腺导管腺癌风险因素的重新评估，旨在推进精准风险分层；由于未提供摘要，无法总结具体研究发现。

items.title_cn: 入院时METS-IR与高甘油三酯性急性胰腺炎患者重症急性胰腺炎的关系：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Admission METS-IR in relation to severe acute pancreatitis among patients with hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis: a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 背景 高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）伴随显著的代谢异常，但少有研究探讨这种代谢负荷的综合指标是否与重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）相关。胰岛素抵抗代谢评分（METS-IR）由空腹血糖、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇、甘油三酯和体重指数计算得出，可从常规可获得的临床数据中计算，无需进行胰岛素检测。然而，其与HTG-AP中SAP的关联尚不明确。目的 本研究探讨HTG-AP患者入院时METS-IR与SAP之间的关联，并通过亚组分析和敏感性分析评估该关联的稳健性。方法 我们回顾性构建了一个单中心队列，纳入2019年1月至2025年7月期间因HTG-AP入院的456例成人患者。采用逻辑回归评估METS-IR作为连续暴露变量和四分位数分组的效应。进行了限制性立方样条分析、亚组分析和敏感性分析。探索性ROC分析比较了其表观判别能力与TyG、TyG-BMI和BISAP的区别。结果 456例患者中78例（17.1%）发生SAP。SAP组METS-IR中位数为69.99（IQR，61.92–83.67），非SAP组为58.18（IQR，51.47–66.46）。在模型3中，METS-IR每增加一个点与SAP的更高比值比相关（OR，1.06；95% CI，1.04–1.08）。在额外调整TG、TG/HDL-C和TyG后，估计值有所减弱（OR，1.03；95% CI，0.997–1.064；P = 0.073）。表观AUC为METS-IR 0.730、TyG 0.720、BISAP 0.758；两两比较均未显示统计学显著差异。在三分类分析中，METS-IR与SAP vs. MAP的关联强于MSAP vs. MAP。结论 入院时较高的METS-IR与HTG-AP患者SAP的更高比值比独立相关。METS-IR可能为HTG-AP患者的早期临床评估提供一种易于获取的代谢负荷指标，但其临床实用性需在前瞻性多中心研究中加以确认。
items.abstract_en: Background Hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is accompanied by significant metabolic abnormalities, but few studies have investigated whether a composite measure of this metabolic burden is associated with severe acute pancreatitis (SAP). The metabolic score for insulin resistance (METS-IR), derived from fasting glucose, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, triglycerides, and body mass index, can be calculated from routinely available clinical data without requiring an insulin assay. However, its association with SAP in HTG-AP remains poorly characterized. Objective This study investigates the association between admission METS-IR and SAP in patients with HTG-AP and assesses the robustness of this association through subgroup and sensitivity analyses. Methods We retrospectively assembled a single-center cohort of 456 adults admitted with HTG-AP between January 2019 and July 2025. Logistic regression evaluated METS-IR as a continuous exposure and in quartiles. Restricted cubic splines, subgroup analyses, and sensitivity analyses were performed. Exploratory ROC analyses compared apparent discrimination with TyG, TyG-BMI, and BISAP. Results SAP occurred in 78 of 456 patients (17.1%). Median METS-IR was 69.99 (IQR, 61.92–83.67) in the SAP group and 58.18 (IQR, 51.47–66.46) in the non-SAP group. In Model 3, each one-point increase in METS-IR was associated with higher odds of SAP (OR, 1.06; 95% CI, 1.04–1.08). After additional adjustment for TG, TG/HDL-C, and TyG, the estimate was attenuated (OR, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.997–1.064; P = 0.073). Apparent AUCs were 0.730 for METS-IR, 0.720 for TyG, and 0.758 for BISAP; neither paired comparison showed a statistically significant difference. In the three-category analysis, the METS-IR association was stronger for SAP vs. MAP than for MSAP vs. MAP. Conclusion Higher admission METS-IR was independently associated with higher odds of SAP in patients with HTG-AP. METS-IR may provide a readily available measure of metabolic burden for early clinical assessment of patients with HTG-AP, although its clinical utility requires confirmation in prospective multicenter studies.
items.summary_cn: 在456例高甘油三酯性急性胰腺炎患者中，入院METS-IR每升高1分与重症急性胰腺炎风险增加相关（OR 1.06，95%CI 1.04–1.08），但进一步校正TG、TG/HDL-C和TyG后关联减弱（OR 1.03，P=0.073）；METS-IR的AUC为0.730，与TyG（0.720）和BISAP（0.758）相比无显著差异。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
